title: Extend illustrative-address disclaimer to opaque 0200::/8 placeholders in 11-lci examples
description: Security-review P3 finding from project-LICHEN-worker6-l87u. spec/11-lci.md node-primary examples at ~lines 325 ('"root": "0200:1234:5678:9abc::1"'), 598, 608, 620, 633, 652 use opaque placeholder /128s (0200:...::1, ::aaaa:bbbb:cccc:dddd, ::1111:2222:3333:4444). These do NOT embed an IID (no downgrade invitation) and are valid AddrForKey output shapes, but the new note at 11-lci.md:296-298 tells readers a real primary is bit-packed AddrForKey bytes, and the global 'illustrative shorthand' disclaimer at line ~181 covers only fe80::1. Extend that disclaimer (or add one sentence near §17.5 examples) stating that all 0200:1234:5678:9abc::... addresses in this document are illustrative placeholders, not literal AddrForKey outputs. Docs-polish only; no normative change. Low priority.
